findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

There was not any soap or paper towels observed at the handwashing sink. The operator was able to provide paper towels at the sink, but did not have any soap. Ensure that there is always soap and paper towels to allow for proper handwashing at the handwashing sink. A follow up is scheduled on 2/24/2025 to ensure that the facility has obtained soap.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment:
3-602.11(B)(1)-(4) and (6) Food Labels. (B) Label information shall include: (1) The common name of the FOOD, or absent a common name, an adequately descriptive identity statement; (2) If made from two or more ingredients, a list of ingredients and subingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, including a declaration of artificial colors, artificial flavors and chemical preservatives, if contained in the FOOD; (3) An accurate declaration of the net quantity of contents; (4) The name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer, or distributor; and (6) Except as exempted in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act § 403(q)(3) - (5), nutrition labeling as specified in 21 CFR 101 - Food Labeling and 9 CFR 317 Subpart B Nutrition Labeling. 

There are prepackaged cuts of meat, smoked fish parts, and frozen produce in the facility that are not labeled with the common name of the product or the cooking instructions. All food needs to be labeled with the common name of the product and all meat needs labeled with cooking instructions. Discussed placing a general cooking instructions label on the outside of the freezers. Discussed reaching out to supplier about labels for the cuts of meat. Ensure that produce that is placed into a bag to be froze has the common name of the product. A follow up is scheduled on 3/5/2025 to ensure that all of these items have been labeled.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided. 

It is observed that the facility has removed their handwashing sink that was in the back storage room next to the fridge. This handwashing sink needs replaced to allow for handwashing. A follow up is scheduled for 2/19/2025 to ensure that this handwashing sink has been replaced.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
The back outside door is missing the bottom seal.  Discussed with PIC, who has the piece, but has not put it on.  Ensure this part is installed to protect rodent and pest entry.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
The back sink by the refrigerator is leaking underneath.  Discussed with PIC, remove wet cardboard and clean floor to prevent mold growth.  Ensure the sink is repaired or put out of use.

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Observed the interior of freezers in the backroom to be soiled with accumulated food crumbs. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 Back floor is observed soiled with facility debris (cardboard and food spills). Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
1) The front glass 3 door display freezer was observed to have raw meats stored above ready to eat items such as okra and pre-cooked beef and chicken. This freezer was re-organized during the inspection to display proper cold storage organization. 2) Observed the chest freezer in the corner farthest from the back door to have raw chicken and raw fish stored above and intermingled with precooked items, as well as vegetables. 3) Observed the chest freezer closest to the back door (vegetable freezer) to have a box of seafood on top of the vegetables.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed significant ice accumulation in all of the chest freezers. Defrost the freezers. 2) Also observed raw wood pallets being used for storage in the back store room. Seal or paint raw wood. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Ensure test strips are obtained to test chlorine sanitizer buckets. No test strips were found on site during inspection. 
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Hand sinks in both the restroom and the back room have poor water pressure, as well as no hot water available. Hand sinks must have sufficient water pressure and provide hot water.
750-1120 Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.
750-1030 Water under pressure at the required temperature shall be provided to all fixtures and equipment that use water.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the mop sink drain to be dripping onto the floor where the pipe is connected to the wall. There is a strong sewage odor present througout the back of the facility, specifically in the bathroom. 
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
Observed the drain pipe at the two compartment sink to extend down into the drain collar creating a cross connection. Since the last inspection, owner has attempted to repair the issues with this drain by sealing pipes together with some sort of rubber cement. Apparently there has been an issue with the landlord. Landlord told tennant that the water was repaired when it is obvious that it is not. Drain pipes must provide an air gap. A licensed plumber must be consulted to correct this issue and provide an air gap. 
750-1060 There shall be no cross-connection between the safe-water supply and any unsafe or questionable water supply, or any source of pollution through which the safe water supply might become contaminated. Abate in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floors in the back storage room to be in poor condition with laminate flooring torn up and peeling away from the tile below. Repair floors so that they are smooth and easily cleanable. 2) Observed the coving along the back wall of the store to be missing behind the upright cooler and freezer. Replace coving. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed a hole in the wall where a light switch plate once was in the back room.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
1) Meat in facility is purchased in bulk from suppliers and has been repackaged into clear bags that are tied at the top at the facility itself. All of these items were discarded and destroyed during the spot check today. Facility may not re-package meat on site because she does not have the facilities to do so. Rodney Cruise of IDOA advised to purchase these items packaged for retail from suppliers. 2) Observed some sort of dough balls in a chest freezer in the back and a couple of bags of goat in the chest freezer in the front of the store that were brought in from a friend to be stored for a party on Saturday. Food from the public may not be brought in and stored with foods for sale. 
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed two bags of bread on the front counter that have multiple fruit flies inside the bag. These bags of bread were discarded during the spot check today. Do not sell foods that are contaminated with pests.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed multiple coolers and freezers that have improper storage of potentially hazardous foods. Chest freezers in the back room have turkey and red meat stored on top of fish and items such as okra. In the front reach in freezer there is chicken stored above red meat which is stored above fish. Most of these meat items were discarded during the spot check today. Those that remain must be stored in proper cold storage organization with ready to eat products such as produce stored on the top, then fish below that, then red meats and chicken stored on the bottom. A handout will be brought to the facility to illustrate such.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed fish and half chickens stored in the bottom of the reach in freezer that are open and not packaged in any manner. All foods should be covered or packaged to protect from potential contamination.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the lid to the Kenmore chest freezer in the back to be separating from the top. Repair lid so that freezer lid is in good condition and free from crevices.2) Observed the seal on this chest freezer to be separating from the lid. Replace seal. 3) Observed significant ice accumulation in all of the chest freezers. Defrost freezers. 4) Observed rust in some of the chest freezers. Paint or seal rust.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
1) Observed spray paint stored on top of boxes of food in the back room as well as paint cans stored intermingled in with food on the bottom shelf of the shelving unit just inside the back room. 2) Observed an open tray of mouse bait sitting on top of a mouse trap underneath the two compartment sink. Store chemicals away from and below any food for sale and all bait for pests must be contained. Remove bait. Spray paint was moved during inspection and she reports that the food on the bottom shelf with the paint cans she just removed from retail shelves yesterday because they are expired. This food should be discarded then. 
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Facility is repackaging and vacuum sealing potentially hazardous foods. This is outside of the realm of a low risk/retail permit. Owner is going to check with suppliers to see if they are able to package in smaller retail quantities for her. If not, facility will need to upgrade to a medium risk facility (still would not be able to vacuum package) as outlined in the General Comments section on page 2 of this report.
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed meat in bags in the display freezer that are not labeled at all. These are items (goat meat products) that are being re-packaged at the store. Apparently the label maker was broken. Repair label maker and label all of these items in a similar manner to what other products labeled at the facility are labeled.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:

Seal or paint raw wood. 3) CORRECTED> Observed bubble wrap on the handles of the reach in freezer. Bubble wrap was removed during inspection. 4) Observed cardboard being used on some of the pallets in the front and on some of the shelving in the reach in freezer. Cease the use of cardboard as this is not an easily cleanable surface. 5) Observed many of the chest freezers to have an accumulation of ice on the sides. Defrost chest freezers.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.comment:
No sanitizer is available on site. Facility has a scale in the back that is used for weighing fish and goat that she re-packages. Plain bleach must be available on site to sanitize and clean the scale appropriately. A handout was left with the facility.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed black wastewater in the mop bucket in the back of the stock room. Empty mop bucket after use and do not let wastewater sit around as this can contribute to pests. There are a few drain flies observed in this area as well. Mop bucket was emptied during inspection to correct the violation.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
